concerns.location: tasks.md:T009 vs quickstart.md:Running the Full Workflow
concerns.text: T009 verifies `python code/pipeline.py --full`, but quickstart.md and plan.md document `python code/main.py --full-batch` (and `pipeline.py --full-batch`). The verified full-run command differs from the documented one; pick one entry point/flag so the execution-order chain (T004 single-run → T009 full run) is consistent.

quickstart says the minimal example 'updates the bootstrap stats for that condition', but bootstrap.py is only implemented in T007 and bootstrap_stats.json is not produced until after T005/T007. T004's pipeline must not invoke the bootstrap stage; either scope T004's pipeline to loader→simulation→MSD/diffusion→MAE only (as its own text says) and fix the quickstart claim, or the ordering implies a consumer (bootstrap) before its producer.

T002 builds boxes of ~150 molecules while plan.md Phase 1 and research.md specify ≈300 molecules/solvent. Not an ordering violation per se, but the producer task (T002) emits trajectories whose parameters contradict the plan the downstream Yeh–Hummer correction (T003) and sensitivity/bootstrap consumers assume; reconcile the system size so downstream artifacts are comparable.
